intent: Evaluate genuine GenEnv generated PUBLIC SYNTHETIC environment vectors as executable graph-composition challenges; select development environment on training evidence; confirm on disjoint prospective-style public development cohorts; feed bounded choice to next run's non-privileged advisory, never to protected science.
generator_data: Current source-bound cmd/forge-model-free-loop produces 2 Promptbreeder text candidates and 2 GenEnv structured vector artifacts per lane. Each GenEnv candidate must exactly match the existing source-bound generator's reported artifact hash, have length 3 and be unused for scientific promotion.
mechanism_kind: ENGINEERED GRAPH CHALLENGE ENVIRONMENTS, NOT EXECUTABLE NOVEL MODELS

task_spec.positive: one variable-consistent typed directed path from START to TARGET with exact hop count and role sequence; only target-path variable-link pair changes sign across paired negative
task_spec.negative: same graph/edges/roles but exactly one variable-binding connection on target path broken; distractors must not create alternative valid path
task_spec.blind_baseline: role_oblivious_reachability, cannot observe the changed binding link
anti_shortcuts: paired identical topology and role sequence except one variable pair
new node aliases, edge shuffle, and distractor branches on each training/confirmation seed
matching labels independent of generated candidate ID
explicit checks no accidental valid negative path

selection.score: mean paired oracle_correct - mean paired depth2_control_correct, only if oracle >= 90%; compare on same number of pairs; larger is more discriminating
selection.tie_break: lower source candidate index wins; no heldout/test tuning
selection.confirm: re-evaluate the frozen train winner on new disjoint confirmation cohort; also evaluate loser to disclose selection winner generalization, do not rank again on confirmation
selection.scientific_success: NONE; selection improves development-environment discrimination only; not claims of learned structure or independent scientific improvement
selection.failures: retain negatives, no scientific promotion even on all-perfect confirmations

feedback: archive source-bound selected generated candidate, vector, 2-candidate TRAIN and 2-candidate disjoint confirmation scores; make next-run F120 research-intake advice data available through verified artifact but do NOT overwrite F118 engineering fitness
